title: L106 — THE STOP THAT NEVER EXISTED
voice: Two challengers take the same string of losses. One stops trading after the third — the other keeps going.
First there's no rule for a fourth loss, because three was never supposed to happen either.
Nothing in the market closes an account for you, so a streak runs until a rule outside the market stops it.
By the sixth, the losses are not six mistakes. They are one mistake, repeated because nothing interrupted it.
A limit set before the session is the only thing that can end a streak. Follow KONGRAVE — the mechanics nobody explains.

caption:
Two challengers take the same string of losses. One stops after the third — the other has no rule telling him to.

A losing streak doesn't need a plan to keep running. It only needs the absence of one. The account survives every single loss on its own — it's the sequence that kills it.

A limit set before the session is the only thing that can end a streak.
